correctness.rationale: Complete block-boundary exhaustion follows from the missing 11 pair in the Cantor fixed point. Ternary one positions and palindromicity yield the two arithmetical profiles with correct quantifiers and boundaries for every k>=1. A lattice intersection produces the exact finite sum. The t=3*2^(k-2) construction yields 2*3^(k-3)+1 distinct non-identical equal-profile factor pairs for every k>=3. The standalone checker reenumerated all profile sets at k=1..7 and collision witnesses at k=3..7; the infinity claim rests on the proof.

The separately proved 2*3^(k-3)+1 family of distinct equal-profile pairs shows a linear-order loss of injectivity, in genuine structural contrast to Sturmian and Tribonacci complexity results; no downstream paper-sized theorem is required.
